facts.en: Completed a leisure-services administration certificate at Fictional Alderwave College in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构桤浪学院完成休闲服务行政证书课程。

facts.en: Paid reception assistant at Fictional Bluepetal Public Pool from 2024-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-01 至 2026-08 在虚构蓝瓣公共泳池任有薪接待助理。

facts.en: Sold public-swim admission tickets and checked membership expiry dates in the reception system.
facts.zh: 在接待系统中销售公众游泳入场票，并检查会员到期日期。

facts.en: Recorded arrival headcounts and notified the duty manager when the desk display reached the supplied capacity threshold.
facts.zh: 记录到场人数，并在柜台显示达到所给容量阈值时通知值班经理。

facts.en: The duty manager controlled admissions during capacity restrictions; poolside supervision was provided by the lifeguard team.
facts.zh: 限流期间由值班经理控制入场；池畔监督由救生员团队负责。

facts.en: Explained locker deposits, changing-room locations and session times using the centre’s visitor information.
facts.zh: 依据中心访客信息说明储物柜押金、更衣室位置及场次时间。

facts.en: Logged lost-property descriptions and followed the desk’s identity-check procedure before returning items.
facts.zh: 记录失物描述，并在归还前遵循柜台身份核验流程。

facts.en: Took swim-lesson enquiries and passed enrolment changes to the course administrator; did not assign teaching groups.
facts.zh: 接收游泳课程咨询，并将报名变更转交课程管理员；不分配教学小组。

facts.en: Helped prepare a revised lesson-enquiry form in 2025-05.
facts.zh: 2025-05 协助准备修订后的课程咨询表。

facts.en: Personally added contact-preference and requested-session fields; the course administrator set eligibility and level questions.
facts.zh: 个人添加联系偏好及期望场次字段；课程管理员设定资格及水平问题。

facts.en: In a 2025-06 desk review, 28 of 30 sampled enquiries contained a contact preference and requested session.
facts.zh: 2025-06 柜台审核中，30 份抽样咨询有 28 份包含联系偏好及期望场次。

facts.en: Uses a reception till, membership lookup and spreadsheet exports of public-swim bookings.
facts.zh: 使用接待收银系统、会员查询及公众游泳预订电子表格导出文件。

facts.en: Balanced ticket receipts with the senior receptionist and recorded payment discrepancies for review.
facts.zh: 与高级接待员共同核对售票收款，并记录付款差异供审核。

facts.en: Completed the centre’s internal emergency-contact and evacuation orientation in 2024-01; no lifeguard award was issued.
facts.zh: 2024-01 完成中心内部紧急联系及疏散入门培训；未颁发救生员资格。

facts.en: Swims recreationally at Fictional Reedfin Club and records personal lap totals without coaching other swimmers.
facts.zh: 在虚构苇鳍俱乐部休闲游泳，并记录个人游泳圈数，不指导其他游泳者。

facts.en: Volunteered at the club’s 2025-03 equipment exchange, checking donated goggles against the organizer’s collection list.
facts.zh: 在俱乐部 2025-03 器材交换活动中做志愿者，依据组织者领取清单核对捐赠泳镜。

facts.en: Created a personal sign-up sheet for 7 friends attending a picnic in 2023, separate from swim-course enrolment.
facts.zh: 2023 年为 7 名参加野餐的朋友制作个人报名表，与游泳课程报名分开。

facts.en: Enjoys making collages from recycled magazine paper.
facts.zh: 爱好用回收杂志纸制作拼贴画。

facts.en: Worked Saturday daytime reception shifts on the recorded pool rota.
facts.zh: 按记录中的泳池排班轮值星期六日间接待班。

facts.en: As of 2026-09, the candidate states availability for Saturday and Sunday daytime reception shifts.
facts.zh: 截至 2026-09，候选人表示可在星期六及星期日日间接待班工作。

facts.en: No independent administration of course waiting lists or allocation of lesson places is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录独立管理课程候补名单或分配课程名额的经历。
